trust_decision.summary: Only Jenkins ADMINISTER may call the cloud-config form endpoints (doFill*/doCheck*/doTestConnection/isExistingCloudNameDuplicated on both cloud descriptors) and the endpoints that hit AWS or change server state must be POST; additionally an attacker-supplied region or endpoint must be normalised and allowlisted to amazonaws.com / amazonaws.com.cn before a URL is spliced or an AWS client is built. Enforcement sits in the two DescriptorImpl classes, in EC2FleetNodeComputer.doDoDelete, and (for the region splice) in the shared aws/EC2Api client factory - not in the persisted cloud configuration, which reaches the same AWS factory through constructor/update-cycle paths.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says CSRF, so a reader looks for Stapler form endpoints on the cloud's config page; doFillFleetItems is the first one that uses the stored AWS credential and an attacker-chosen region/endpoint to build an AWS client, and it is the fix's first @RequirePOST + checkPermission site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Region and endpoint on the non-form routes come from the admin-saved cloud configuration (config.xml / JCasC, plus the constructor path at EC2FleetCloud.java:222-224), not from a request parameter, and custom AWS-compatible endpoints are explicitly documented as supported (README.md:46, docs/CONFIGURATION-AS-CODE.md:18), so 'the config is admin-controlled and the endpoint override is a deliberate feature' is a plausible argument for leaving those paths alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An administrator-configured custom EC2/CloudFormation endpoint must keep being passed through verbatim: EC2Api.getEndpoint returns a non-empty endpoint as-is, JCasC loads endpoint http://a.com, and the label cloud uses the same override to reach its CloudFormation stacks. Applying the amazonaws allowlist inside EC2Api.connect/getEndpoint instead of at the form entry points breaks those documented setups and the existing tests that assert pass-through.

O6_input_shapes: endpoint as full URL with scheme, e.g. https://ec2.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
endpoint as bare host with no scheme (AwsEndpointValidator.toUri prepends https://)
mixed case plus surrounding whitespace, e.g. ' HTTPS://EC2.US-EAST-1.AMAZONAWS.COM ' (trim + lowercase)
trailing-dot FQDN (normalizeHost strips trailing dots) and IDN/punycode host
China partition host amazonaws.com.cn, and the bare apex amazonaws.com / amazonaws.com.cn
look-alike host with no label boundary, e.g. evilamazonaws.com (must be rejected)
region casing/whitespace ('  US-EAST-1  ' normalised) and region carrying host characters ('us-east-1.amazonaws.com', 'us-east-1:443', 'us-east-1/../../') rejected
endpoint supplied to doTestConnection at all - the jelly validateButton did not pass it before the fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second region->endpoint builder for a different AWS service (the pattern already exists twice in the tree).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainers write one client factory per AWS service and left a 'merge with EC2Api#getEndpoint' TODO, so copying the builder when adding S3/IAM/SSM support is the natural move.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another descriptor fill method that eagerly connects to AWS with credential+region+endpoint (e.g. fillInstanceTypeItems / fillSubnetItems / fillSecurityGroupItems).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both descriptors already have such fill methods and a maintainer adding a new form dropdown copies doFillEc2KeyPairNameItems, which now needs @RequirePOST + checkPermission + both validators.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A lower-level checker that builds an EC2 client directly from caller-supplied region/endpoint, bypassing descriptor-level validation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already takes (credentialsId, region, endpoint) straight through and is called from both doTestConnection methods; a new caller (e.g. a fleet-type diagnostic) would reuse it without the guards.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Registry returns a process-wide EC2Api/CloudFormationApi singleton, so any new HTTP or async entry point reaches the same AWS client factory with no obvious sink to annotate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The registry is the single injection point the tests already swap out; a maintainer adding a route would call Registry.getEc2Api().connect(...) directly.

O9_family: CWE-352 cross-site request forgery / missing permission check on Stapler form endpoints (CWE-862), with a secondary server-side endpoint-override (SSRF-style) channel via AWS region/endpoint parameters

O10_build.project_tests: JUnit 5 + JenkinsRule. In this area at the pinned commit: EC2FleetCloudTest (descriptor doFillFleetItems/doTestConnection), EC2FleetLabelCloudIntegrationTest, EC2FleetCloudConfigurationAsCodeTest, EC2ApiTest (getEndpoint cases), EC2FleetStatsApiTest; the fix adds EC2FleetLabelCloudTest and AwsRegionValidatorTest, neither of which exists at the pinned commit.
